title: Bound for the binomial-tail recurrence
statement: Let $D$ be a natural number with $1\le D$, and define $B_D$ by $B_D(m,0)=0$, $B_D(0,j+1)=1$, and $B_D(m+1,j+1)=B_D(m,j)/D+(1-1/D)B_D(m,j+1)$. For all natural numbers $L$ and $j$, $(L+1)B_D(L,j)\le jD$.
hypotheses_covered: $D$ is a natural number with $1\le D$
